name: Layout probe 2
description: Window check fixture: a tab view without sidebar defaults that reports its size and text size and exposes a line of text and an empty area.

status.name: layoutprobe2.surface
status.description: The surface id, the size and scale of the tab view, and the text size of the surface with the height of the text drawn at 13 points times it.

element.name: layoutprobe2.text
element.description: The line of text of the view, drawn at 13 points times the text size of the surface.

element.name: layoutprobe2.empty
element.description: The empty area of the view below its text, painted only with the card background.
